Players of all ages will have the chance to win and adopt their very own 3D-printed dragon . Bring your family, test your luck, and enjoy an evening of fun and friendly competition. events.description: Take home a dinosaur egg and uncover your very own glow-in-the-dark dinosaur! Stop by the Eielson Library to pick up a dinosaur excavation kit while supplies last. This free take-home activity requires no registration and is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Craft is made for children 5+.

events.title: Pool Tournament
events.description: Join us on November 7 from 1–3 PM at the Community Center for a FREE Pool Tournament open to ages 7 and up. Whether you’re an experienced player or trying your hand at pool for the first time, everyone is welcome to participate. Challenge friends, test your skills, and enjoy some friendly competition for a chance to win an FSS gift card. No registration is required—just show up ready to play and have fun.

events.description: Let the Yukon Club Do the Cooking This Thanksgiving! Enjoy a gourmet Thanksgiving without the stress. Our chefs have crafted a special menu featuring brined, slow-roasted turkey breast, artisanal stuffing, hand-whipped sweet potato puree, cranberry-orange relish, buttery garlic green beans, and rich pecan pie. All dishes are prepared and picked up cold, ready for easy rewarming just in time for Thanksgiving. Meal for 2: $50 Meal for 4: $100 Reserve and pay by 4 PM on Friday, Nov. 23. Pick up on Nov. 26 from 12-4 PM at the Bonfire Grille. RESERVE YOUR SPOT HERE

events.title: Bingo
events.description: Join us for Bingo at the Community Center! FREE and open to ages 7+. This family-friendly afternoon is a great way to relax, have fun, and enjoy some friendly competition with the community. Gather your lucky charms, bring your game face, and see if you can call out BINGO first. Arrive early to grab your seat and get ready for a fun-filled hour at the Community Center.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Use the official newcomers page for Eielson AFB reporting instructions.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival for on-base waitlists and off-base referrals. Temporary lodging is available through the base lodging office where offered.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival and assist with base orientation. Contact your gaining unit if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource, Military.com, and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
